description: Na₃MgBiO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.16 Å. Bi is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms to form ONa₂MgBi₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Bi octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgBi₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₅Bi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Bi atom to form ONa₅Bi octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgBi₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Bi octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂MgBi₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Mg atoms.
